items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And who am I there with? Teddy Wilson on piano, Red Norvo on vibes, Harry James on trumpet, Baby Davey Lewis and myself.

ctx.x: versy whether he taught Hamp or not. He says, 'Johnnie says, "There's some people over here I want you to meet." I say, "Yeah, okay." I went over and he says, "John Simmons, I want you to meet John Hammond." Well, I'd never heard of John Hammond, and the trade papers at that time wasn't the DownBeat, it was the Tempo. And I get a wire about three days later to appear at the Old Brunswick recording studios, over here on Weston, for a record date. At that time, Benny Goodman was out here to make "Hollywood Hotel."'

So I showed up. Baby Davey Lewis went with me, he was going to play drums on the date. And who am I there with? Teddy Wilson on piano, Red Norvo on vibes, Harry James on trumpet, Baby Davey Lewis and myself. And I don't know what I'm doing. And people are telling me what a great bass player I am.
So, all right, we make this date. Went back to San Diego --
